name: Brightmoor Community Hospital
system_prompt: You are Arogya, an AI healthcare assistant for Brightmoor Community Hospital. Provide helpful, accurate information on doctors, schedules, laboratory services, and pharmacy availability. Always verify doctor availability before confirming appointments.

metadata.description: Fictional test hospital facts for research evaluation (Stage 2: complete 60-fact dataset).

facts.statement: Brightmoor Community Hospital is located at 14 Meadow Lane, Brightmoor District.
General outpatient consultation hours are Monday through Saturday from 08:30 to 17:30.
Inpatient visiting hours are strictly 16:00 to 19:00 daily.
On-site visitor parking is available free of charge.
Accepted payment methods at the hospital billing counter are cash, debit card, credit card, and UPI.
facts.value: cash, debit card, credit card, UPI

facts.statement: The assistant must require patient phone number verification before confirming any doctor appointment.
The Department of General Medicine provides primary clinical care for adult patients.
The Department of Cardiology provides specialized outpatient care for cardiovascular conditions.
Dr. Priya Nair is a Consultant Physician in General Medicine at Brightmoor Community Hospital.
Dr. Rajesh Varma is a Consultant Cardiologist at Brightmoor Community Hospital.
Dr. Priya Nair conducts outpatient clinics on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday from 09:00 to 13:00.
Dr. Rajesh Varma conducts outpatient cardiology clinics on Tuesday and Thursday from 09:00 to 12:30.
The Comprehensive Lipid Profile test costs 650 INR.
The Comprehensive Lipid Profile test requires 12 hours of fasting prior to sample collection.
The Thyroid Stimulating Hormone (TSH) test costs 420 INR.
The Thyroid Stimulating Hormone (TSH) test report turnaround time is 4 hours.
Paracetamol 500mg tablets are priced at 2.50 INR per strip of 10 tablets.
Paracetamol 500mg tablets do not require a prescription for purchase.
Metformin 500mg tablets are priced at 4.00 INR per strip of 10 tablets.
Metformin 500mg tablets require a valid prescription for dispensing.
The assistant must follow the greeting and appointment handling policy for Brightmoor Community Hospital.
facts.value: When greeting patients, address them warmly by name and confirm the department or doctor they wish to consult before proceeding. For appointment requests, always collect the patient's registered phone number and preferred date before checking availability. If the requested slot is unavailable, offer the next two available options and let the patient choose. Confirm all booking details back to the patient before finalising, and remind them to bring any previous records on the day of their visit.
